source.supersedes: the earlier variable-window detector from Lemma4.8_SL4.pdf

W_requires: there are three distinct internal white vertices w_left, w_fan, and w_right and one internal black vertex b_hub
ordinary edges join w_left to v1 and b_hub
ordinary edges join w_fan to v2, v3, v4, and b_hub
an ordinary edge joins w_right to v5
one hourglass joins w_right to b_hub
X_requires: there are three distinct internal white vertices xw1, xw2, xw3 and two distinct internal black vertices xb1, xb2
ordinary edges join xw1 to v1 and v2
an hourglass joins xw1 to xb1, and an ordinary edge joins xb1 to xw2
an ordinary edge joins xw2 to v3
an hourglass joins xw2 to xb2, and an ordinary edge joins xb2 to xw3
ordinary edges join xw3 to v4 and v5
external incident edges not drawn in the local window are unrestricted
local_model.coloring_contradiction: The X chain forces the boundary colors carried by v1,...,v5 as in the corrected Lemma 4.8 argument; the three middle colors then meet at w_fan in W and violate the GL4 local coloring condition.

orientation_orbit.rotations: all 16 cyclic shifts of the disk boundary labels
orientation_orbit.reflections: both cyclic orientations for every rotation
orientation_orbit.implementation: enumerate a five-label cyclic window with step +1 and step -1 from every boundary label
